findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：光通訊市場已成熟、日益商品化；既有對手與以亞洲為主的新進入者近年加劇競爭，造成價格壓力。
findings.excerpt: Both legacy competitors as well as new entrants, predominantly Asia-based competitors, have intensified market competition in recent years leading to pricing pressure.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：競爭對手可能以新品或激進低價取得或保住份額，且公司自稱對手中許多資源較大；若供給跟不上需求，可能流失份額。
findings.excerpt: Our competitors may continue to enter markets or gain or retain market share through introduction of new or improved products or with aggressive low pricing strategies that may impact the efficacy of our approach.

findings.claim: 10-K 自述依營收與市占為光子產業領先供應商（公司自述，未附具體份額數字）。
findings.excerpt: an industry-leading provider of optical and photonic products based on revenue and market share

findings.claim: TrendForce：EML/CW-DFB 雷射供應集中，Lumentum、Broadcom 等合計高占比
findings.excerpt: Given the high technical barriers, the top three suppliers—Lumentum, Broadcom, and Mitsubishi Electric—collectively hold approximately 72% market share.
